name: Laguna Phuket Marathon 2027
short_description: The Laguna Phuket Marathon 2027 runs the marathon and half marathon on Sunday 13 June 2027 from Laguna Grove, Laguna Phuket, Thailand, with 10 km, 5 km and 2 km races the previous afternoon.
ai_summary: The Laguna Phuket Marathon 2027 is held at Laguna Grove, Laguna Phuket, in Cherngtalay near Bang Thao on Phuket's west coast, Thailand. The 2 km junior run, 10 km and 5 km are on the afternoon of Saturday 12 June 2027, and the marathon (42.195 km) and half marathon (21.1 km) on Sunday 13 June, with new earlier start times of 3am and 4.30am. The marathon has a 7 hour 30 minute limit; the 20th edition in June 2026 drew more than 7,000 competitors.
pros: Seven and a half hour marathon limit with water every 2 to 2.5 km
Resort start at Laguna Grove with a free shuttle from nearby car parks
Saturday 2 km, 5 km and 10 km races make it a family weekend
Shallow field: 3:09 was tenth among men in 2026, and every age group gets trophies
cons: Humid heat: 27°C and 89% humidity at the 4am start in 2026, 30°C by 8am
Two climbs to about 45 m, the second after 29 km
Roads are only partly closed; the organiser warns of light traffic on the course
Very early starts, moving to 3am for the marathon in 2027

faqs.question: When is the Laguna Phuket Marathon 2027 taking place?
faqs.answer: The marathon and half marathon are on Sunday 13 June 2027, starting at 3am and 4.30am, which are new earlier times. The 2 km junior run, 10 km and 5 km are on Saturday 12 June from 4pm, and race-pack collection and the expo start on Friday 11 June, according to the organiser.

faqs.question: What distance options are available at this race?
faqs.answer: Five: a 42.195 km marathon, a 21.1 km half marathon, a 10 km, a 5 km and a 2 km junior run. The marathon cut-off is 7 hours 30 minutes, with an intermediate cut-off at 21.1 km after 3 hours 37 minutes, and the half marathon closes four hours after its start.

faqs.question: Where exactly is the race held?
faqs.answer: All races start and finish at Laguna Grove in the Laguna Phuket resort area at Cherngtalay, near Bang Thao. The marathon heads north-east to Ban Don, north past Thalang to Nai Yang Beach near the airport, then back south past Layan Beach to the finish. Police and marshals control traffic along the route.
